name: Lionheart Fixt
author: vkays
description: A cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt. Releases 0.1.0 'The Horde', 0.1.1 'The Crossroads Patrol' and 0.1.2 'Standing' (release candidate). 0.1.0 is about the goblins: it repairs the four dead-end replies in the goblin thread, restores GoblinGirl and GoblinGuards -- two finished characters that ship with zero map references -- into Goblin Warrens and finishes the Girl's truncated tree, makes the Goblin Horde a real faction with three ranks on the shipped Saladin/Templar pattern, gives Hrubjub's evil path two more ways in and an onward pointer to the Warrens, gives Hub'blub a second store at chum prices, and adds skill and SPECIAL checks to a settlement that previously answered to almost nothing but Speech. Every check adds a route and none removes one, so the vanilla solution to every scene still works.
